verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM documents two first-party routes to natural-language operation. Its official MCP server lets users perform CRM operations from AI tools like Claude Desktop, Cursor and VS Code using natural language, including COQL queries and bulk operations; a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. In-product, Zia can create modules, reports and workflows and retrieve any data you ask for. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably, and detailed docs on the scope and limits of Zia's in-app conversational commands.
